title: Muslim companion: Dhikr
description: A comprehensive Islamic lifestyle application designed to support daily worship with features like prayer times, Quran, and more.
longDescription: Muslim companion: Dhikr is an ad-free Islamic utility app focused on providing a clean and seamless experience for users. It helps in tracking daily prayers, reading the Quran, and finding the Qibla direction, among other features.
features: Accurate Prayer Times with Athan notifications
Quran with translations and audio recitations

title: SHA-STACK
description: A monorepo showcase of my favorite technologies and architectural patterns.
longDescription: SHA-STACK (Shawal's Stack) is a modular monorepo designed to showcase my preferred full-stack technologies. It serves as a living blueprint for modern application development, featuring independent modules for web, mobile, and documentation. The project emphasizes clean architecture, type safety, and automated workflows across different frameworks.
